title: AER debug configuration
description: Launch Apex tests through the aer CLI in DAP debug mode.

request.description: AER test debugging currently supports launch requests only.

args.description: Arguments passed to `aer test --debug`. Defaults to ['.'] when omitted.

stopOnEntry.description: Passed through to the AER debug adapter launch request.

aerPath.description: Optional path to the aer executable. Overrides PATH lookup for this debug configuration.

timeout.description: Optional per-test timeout in seconds. Passed to `aer test --timeout`.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for the adapter process. Defaults to the worktree root.
